summary.text: Mary Schneider is a Democratic state representative from District 21 in Fargo who has served since December 2014 and is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota State Senate seat in District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mary Schneider is an attorney whose legislative biography lists study at NUI Galway, Emory University School of Law and the University of North Dakota School of Law, along with a B.S. in sociology from North Dakota State University.

She was a Bush Foundation Fellow in 2004-2005, served as president of a county bar association, and has received the YWCA Lifetime Achievement Award, a Champion of Justice Award and a Human Rights Award.
She is married and has two children.
Schneider assumed office in the North Dakota House of Representatives on December 1, 2014.
According to Ballotpedia, she is not running for re-election to the House, and no incumbent is running for the District 21 Senate seat.
Her 2025 assignments include the Government and Veterans Affairs and Judiciary committees, and she serves on the interim Health Care Committee.
